summary_en: CUC Inc. entered into a non-application agreement regarding an MBO of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE Co., Ltd. (code 7133), committing not to tender its entire 840,000 shares in the initial public offer, then to sell part of its holding in a subsequent self-tender offer, and ultimately to retain an 11.09% indirect stake through a stock exchange after going private.
title_en: Notice Regarding Execution of Non-Tender Agreement in Connection with Public Tender Offer for Investment Securities
translation_en_brief:
CUC Inc. has executed a non-application agreement with respect to an MBO of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE Co., Ltd. (securities code 7133), whereby CUC will not tender its entire holding of 840,000 shares (representing 11.77% of HYUGA's outstanding shares as of March 31, 2026) in the initial public tender offer launched by JG44. The agreement is part of a structured transaction designed to facilitate HYUGA's going-private process.

Under the terms of the arrangement, CUC will subsequently participate in a self-tender offer by HYUGA to sell a portion of its shares. Following the completion of squeeze-out procedures and HYUGA's transition to a fully private entity, CUC will maintain an indirect interest in HYUGA by retaining an 11.09% stake as a shareholder of JG44, HYUGA's post-transaction parent company, through a stock exchange transaction.

CUC's management determined that HYUGA's enhanced corporate value following the going-private transaction would contribute to long-term shareholder value creation for CUC Group. The public tender offer is scheduled to run from September 28 to November 10, 2026, with settlement beginning November 17, 2026. The subsequent self-tender offer will operate from November 18 to December 16, 2026. CUC expects the transaction to increase equity attributable to the parent by 176 million yen, with no impact on consolidated earnings for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.
